How to Talk About Repair

You don’t need wild promises here. You need clear, simple language, like:

“After you clean up the gut and support digestion, the next step is supporting the lining itself.”

 

From there, your Repair product can be positioned as:

  • The “deeper support” option for customers who want more than basic probiotics
  • The upgrade inside a 12-week gut reset
  • The “if you’ve had gut issues for years, start here” kind of product

Where Repair Fits in Bundles and Protocols

Here’s how smart brands slip Repair into their system:

  • 12-Week Gut Reset:
    • Weeks 1–4: Remove + Replace
    • Weeks 3–12: Reinoculate
    • Weeks 5–12: Add Repair for barrier support

  • Deep Gut Support Bundle:
    • Reinoculate + Repair as a “next level” stack for higher-ticket customers

  • Practitioner or clinic channel:
    • Repair becomes the product they recommend for more complex cases
    • You get credibility by association

The message is simple:

“If we’re going to talk about gut health seriously, we don’t stop at probiotics. We support the lining too.”
